dataset.sectionDescription: Bulk one-row-per-region output from the Zillow Research CSV catalog.
dataset.title: Dataset

geography.description: (mode=marketScan) Region level to scan. Available levels depend on the dataset.
geography.title: Geography

historyMetric.description: (mode=history) Which monthly series to emit as tidy rows.
historyMetric.sectionDescription: Tidy one-row-per-month output for the selected metric.
historyMetric.title: History metric

historyMonths.description: (mode=regionTrends, history) Months of monthly history to include per metric. Zillow's page carries up to 100 months; larger values are capped at 100.
historyMonths.title: History months

locations.description: (mode=regionTrends, history) Cities, states, counties, ZIP codes or neighborhoods, e.g. 'Austin, TX', 'Travis County, TX', '78701', 'Barton Hills, Austin, TX', 'Texas'.
locations.sectionDescription: One location per entry. Zillow's autocomplete resolves the region type and canonical page.
locations.title: Locations

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted records for this run.
maxItems.sectionDescription: The run stops at this many records and says so when it truncates.
maxItems.title: Maximum records

mode.description: What to collect. regionTrends = one detailed record per location. history = tidy monthly rows per location. marketScan = one row per region from a Zillow Research dataset.
enumTitles: Region trends - deep record per location
Market scan - bulk rows from Zillow Research
mode.title: Mode

nameContains.description: (mode=marketScan) Case-insensitive substring filter on the region name, e.g. 'Travis' or 'Springfield'.
nameContains.title: Name contains

regionIds.description: (mode=marketScan) Exact Zillow RegionIDs to keep, e.g. '3101'. Values not in the selected dataset are ignored.
regionIds.title: Region IDs

sortBy.description: (mode=marketScan) Order rows and assign a 1-based rank over all matches before maxItems truncation.
sortBy.title: Sort and rank by

state.description: (mode=marketScan) Keep only regions in this state. 'all' keeps every state.
state.title: State filter

title: Zillow Market Trends Scraper Input
